records.text: A Blackwood furbolg pathfinder in the tribe’s camp south of Auberdine, this scout is part of the threat to Darkshore’s people. It attacks intruders and uses a spell when combat begins.
A Blackwood furbolg warrior guarding the tribe’s camp, this sentry attacks when it catches someone tampering with the fruit or grain stores. It meets intruders with force and uses a combat spell.
A Blackwood furbolg totemic, this combatant serves the tribe in battle and casts a spell when an enemy engages it.
A Blackwood furbolg ursa, this combatant can turn to healing magic when a nearby ally is badly hurt, showing a protective role within the tribe’s fighters.
A Blackwood shaman who uses lightning magic in combat, casting Lightning Bolt after engaging an enemy.
A cursed Highborne undead combatant that casts a spell when it gains an enemy's attention.
A Highborne undead creature that casts a spell when it gains an enemy's attention.
A Wailing Highborne encountered in the region, a humanoid undead combatant. Its response to an attack is to cast a spell.
A Stormscale Wave Rider encountered in the region. Its combat behavior includes casting a spell when injured.
A Stormscale Siren encountered in the region. Its combat behavior includes casting a spell while in combat.
A Stormscale Myrmidon encountered in the region. Its combat behavior includes casting a spell when injured.
A Stormscale Sorceress encountered in the region. Its response to an attack is to cast a spell.
A Stormscale Warrior encountered in the region. Its combat behavior includes using Improved Blocking.
Lady Moongazer is a undead elite in Darkshore. Her combat routine casts one spell when she is attacked and another while she is fighting.
Carnivous the Breaker is a elite humanoid with a personal name and epithet. It can use Thrash and Pierce Armor at close range.
Vile Sprite is a humanoid found in Darkshore.
Wild Grell is a humanoid found in Darkshore.
Licillin is a solitary, powerful undead presence in this part of Kalimdor. Its combat routine opens with one spell on aggro and calls another while the fight continues.

Firecaller Radison is a solitary elemental encountered in Kalimdor. The firecaller name marks a specialized role, and its combat routine invokes magic during battle, including a stronger response as its health falls.
Greymist raiders are armed members of the Greymist presence in Kalimdor. This raider attacks with a combat ability when engaged.
Greymist Coastrunners are numerous across the coastal areas, making them a more common sight than the solitary Greymist raider. This member of the Greymist group may flee when badly hurt.

Greymist seers are magical members of the Greymist group, found across the coastal areas. This seer uses magic when attacked, setting it apart from the raider's opening attack and the coastrunner's tendency to flee under pressure.

Greymist netters are members of the Greymist group found in the coastal area. This netter uses a combat spell as its health drops, a distinct response from the raider's opening attack or the coastrunner's flight.
A Greymist humanoid warrior whose combat routine casts a spell when it draws an enemy's attention.
A Greymist humanoid hunter whose combat routine casts a spell when it draws an enemy's attention.
A Greymist humanoid oracle who casts lightning in combat, can heal a nearby ally, and may flee for help when badly wounded.
A Greymist humanoid tidehunter whose combat routine uses a spell during battle.
A Deth'ryll satyr, a humanoid combatant whose routine uses a spell in battle.

A Blackwood Windtalker is one of the furbolgs encountered in the Blackwood camp south of Auberdine. It is counted among the windtalkers targeted by Terenthis’s request, and its combat behavior includes casting a spell when wounded.
A Dark Strand Fanatic is a humanoid enemy found around the Dark Strand. It fights with a curse it casts while in combat.
A Dark Strand Voidcaller is found at the Dark Strand. It summons a voidwalker while out of combat, marking it as a practitioner of void magic among the local enemies.
A Twilight Disciple serves the Twilight masters and meets intruders with fervent battle cries, declaring its life for them and taunting its foe. It can also heal itself while wounded.
A Twilight Thug serves the Twilight masters and meets intruders with fervent battle cries, declaring its life for them and taunting its foe. In battle it can also use a fear spell.

Hollee is an Explorers' League archaeologist honored to work under the famed Prospector Remtravel. At their Darkshore dig, she says he failed to notice the golems overrunning the site, prompting her to seek help in Auberdine. Worried for his safety, she is reluctant to leave him behind and helps arrange delivery of his mysterious fossil to Chief Archaeologist Greywhisker in Darnassus.

Remtravel is an Explorers' League prospector famed for discoveries at Ironforge's academy, but Hollee describes him as oblivious to his surroundings. His own search remarks show him losing track of his stone brush, Hollee, and whom he is addressing while he hunts the mysterious fossil. Even Green Hills of Stranglethorn distracts him.

Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea protects Auberdine and its surrounding forest, where she sees corruption, danger and Blackwood interference threatening the land. Moonkin drawn to a newly reported red crystal make her cautious: she questions whether it is benign and suspects a connection to Felwood, but admits the crystal's nature and purpose remain unknown. She investigates the threat and takes findings to Auberdine's council, while treating the distant danger as not yet an immediate threat to the village.

Barithras Moonshade is devising a potion from rare mushrooms found in the cave behind Cliffspring Falls. The Grove of the Ancients warned him to stay away, sensing a new evil there, so he asks another to gather the ingredients and scout the cave. He hopes the Ancients are mistaken, yet fears their warning may be confirmed. When Onu seeks to hear what was seen at the falls, Barithras considers the request urgent and directs the traveler to the Ancient of Lore at the grove.

Therylune is a young elf caught near the Master's Glaive after Twilight's Hammer cultists surrounded her. She asks for help escaping and wants word sent to her sister Therysil at the Shrine of Aessina that she is safe. During the escape she thanks her escort and says she can make the rest of the way herself.

Onu, an Ancient of Lore, investigates the Twilight's Hammer presence in Darkshore and the old powers the cult reveres. He asks others to search the Master's Glaive for clues, then studies a cursed, corrupted page from an ancient elven text and seeks Mathystra relics to understand how the cult may use elven magic. The work troubles him; he meditates on the cult's intentions and can provide another scrying phial for communicating through a bowl. His manner is contemplative, and his knowledge of the cult's purpose remains incomplete.

Sentinel Tysha Moonblade is investigating the ruins of Ameth'Aran and its fall. She found tablets recounting the city's history, but fled when its restless spirits accosted her while she read the runes. She asks others to decipher the tablets so she can carry the knowledge to Auberdine and report it to the Circle of Ancients.

Cerellean Whiteclaw is an Auberdine night elf still grieving Anaya Dawnrunner, his beloved from the age of the Well of Eternity. After finding her spirit in Ameth’Aran, he asks for help because he cannot bear to face her himself. His dialogue dwells on their separation and the pain of having destroyed her living form; he later followed Shan’do Stormrage into hibernation with that grief.

Thundris Windweaver is an Auberdine scholar and guardian of the land, concerned with dangerous Highborne magic and corruption in Darkshore. He seeks to destroy relics from Ameth’Aran, investigates the taint in the Cliffspring River, and works against the satyr’s corruption of the Blackwood furbolgs. He also recognizes ancient enemies confronting the draenei on Azuremyst and Bloodmyst and offers Auberdine’s aid.

Asterion is a spectral Highborne held by a magical seal in Bashal'Aran, a prison he says has lasted for centuries. He seeks the seal so it can be destroyed, tracing it through the sprites and grells to a satyr. His account reaches back to the Well's existence and Queen Azshara's court; he has known the changed world only in fragments. Centuries of imprisonment have left him uncertain whether he can recover his former state, and his reunion with civil company comes edged with a sharp, sardonic tongue. He identifies Athrikus, his former master and jailor, as still living and turns from hopelessness toward vengeance.

Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze says her charge is protecting Auberdine. She sent Balthule Shadowstrike to watch the strange activity around the Tower of Althalaxx, and worries when he fails to return, fearing danger in the forest. Her request to have his welfare checked reflects a protective concern for both the settlement and the sentinel she entrusted with the investigation.

Athrikus Narassin leads the Cult of the Dark Strand and is said to reside at the top of the Tower of Althalaxx, surrounded by powerful warlocks. He speaks of diminished powers and defies an opponent who has wounded him; his encounter lines also describe a lethal attack.

Balthule Shadowstrike is a student of Delgren the Purifier, a paladin who has taught him about the Holy Light and battle. He investigates the warlocks gathering at the Tower of Althalaxx, collecting their parchment to understand their purpose. Fearing the Dark Strand's threat is growing, he sends word to Delgren.
In combat, Delmanis the Hated casts Frostbolt and Flame Blast. When badly wounded, he flees for assistance.

Wizbang Cranktoggle is an inventor whose Buzzbox devices let people communicate over long distances, though they need regular maintenance. His inventions and travels are haphazard: after drinking, he has lost fishing gear and electropellers in the water, and asks for help recovering parts for his work.

Anaya Dawnrunner is a restless night elf spirit whose words reveal her love for Cerellean and her longing for rest. Her bound utterance addresses him as “dearest” and speaks of her soul finally resting.

Volcor is Grimclaw’s master, found wounded after evading furbolgs in a cave. He thanks those who bring him the enchanted moonstalker cloak and welcomes Grimclaw warmly. He offers a choice to escape the cave by stealth or force, then directs the adventurer to tell Terenthis they made it out safely.

Terenthis investigates the corruption threatening Auberdine and works to protect its people. He asks adventurers to scout and confront the Blackwood furbolgs, and helps Grimclaw find and rescue his master, Volcor, even crafting a protective cloak for the search. He is concerned for Darkshore and hopes its challenges can be overcome.

Tharnariun Treetender tends to Darkshore’s wildlife and is especially troubled by the plague afflicting the thistle bears. He first seeks to test a possible cure by having a living rabid bear captured; when it fails, he reluctantly orders the sick animals culled to limit their harm to the forest. His final task targets the Den Mother, which he sees as a threat to Auberdine. Though he speaks of the cost in nature’s servants, he thanks those who defend the settlement and hopes to stand beside them against future foes.

Alanndarian Nightsong works in Auberdine on practical problems affecting Darkshore. She has a strider stew recipe she may teach, and she is also investigating why local deer are sick. The contaminated Cliffspring Falls water may be a source of the illness, so she seeks ingredients to prepare a curative salve while studying the sample. She welcomes help sent by the Cenarion Circle and treats the sickness as a shared crisis; the evidence does not establish that a cure has already been completed.

Caylais Moonfeather tends to the hippogryphs, which she regards as noble, proud, swift beasts and an honor to train. Riders can ask her for a flight; she is identified as the hippogryph master serving the route back to Rut’theran.
Dalmond is a general-goods merchant. His counter offers goods, and visitors may also raise a quest with him.
Naram Longclaw is a weaponsmith whose shop offers goods to browse. His title points to his trade: weapons, rather than the general goods sold by nearby merchants.
Shaldyn is a clothier whose shop offers goods to browse. Her trade is clothing, giving her counter a distinct purpose among the nearby merchants.

Mavralyn deals in leather armor and leatherworking supplies. The shop’s goods option lets visitors browse wares suited to that specialty; her title distinguishes her stock from the other local trades.
Harlon Thornguard is an armorer and shieldsmith. His goods counter serves those trades, setting his specialty apart from the other local merchants.
Valdaron is a tailoring-supplies vendor. His local role is straightforward: offering goods for those seeking materials for tailoring.
Kyndri is a baker in the area, offering food goods. The local service menu also marks her as a quest giver, so she has a role beyond selling baked provisions.
Allyndia sells food and drink, with the local menu also identifying her as a quest giver. Her recorded service combines provisions with a quest-related point of contact.
Taldan is a drink vendor. His local service centers on offering drinks, and the service menu also identifies him as a quest giver.

Grondal Moonbreeze is a tailoring trainer. His training dialogue stresses steady hands and patience, and he offers to take a learner under his wing; the conditions for that offer are not established here.
Ullanna is a trade-supplies vendor, offering goods for local trade needs. Her recorded role is distinct from the nearby food and drink sellers.
Tiyani sells food and drink and invites visitors to browse her goods.

Laird is a fish vendor in Auberdine who takes a keen interest in the differences between local fish and those caught near Teldrassil. He asks visitors about fishing there and examines samples Nessa sends him. In his message to her, he suspects the world tree may affect the wildlife, while admitting the cause is uncertain.
Heldan Galesong is a fisherman in Auberdine who also sells goods. His recorded role gives him a practical connection to the town's fishing trade and supplies.
Fiora Longears is an elf and the speaker’s partner, presented as a contact in Auberdine for travelers seeking a Kalimdor adventure.
Auberdine sentinels serve as guards.

The Shade of Elura guards a sunken shipment of elunite near the Auberdine lighthouse. Once the ship's captain, Elura is said to have cursed herself to roam the depths and protect her cargo forever. Her medallion and the lost ore are sought for a warrior's weapon.
Kurdram Stonehammer teaches mining.

Thelgrum Stonehammer supplies mining goods in Auberdine, serving miners who need equipment and materials for their work. His role is practical and local: he offers goods rather than a documented personal story.

Delfrum Flintbeard is a blacksmithing trainer in Auberdine. His greeting mentions an order his father wants finished, giving his work a family connection; when he has time, he can teach visitors with enough skill.

Elisa Steelhand is Auberdine's blacksmithing-supplies vendor and offers repairs. Her services support local smiths and travelers who need gear maintained, though the available evidence gives no further personal detail.

Gorbold Steelhand is a trade-supplies merchant in Auberdine, and he speaks for surviving crew members when asking for the effects of two drowned captains to be recovered. He says the captains were good night elves and wants their belongings cared for; this responsibility reflects a concern for the crew and the dead sailors' memory.

Gelkak Gyromast is a stranded pirate captain whose ship sank off Darkshore. He is concerned with restoring his first mate to working order: he asks for the pieces of the broken key needed to reactivate it, then directs help in bringing it back. His speech is that of a boisterous, theatrical captain, and his plans include revenge on the murlocs responsible for trouble near the wreck.
The Threshwackonator 4100 is Captain Gelkak Gyromast’s mechanical first mate, started with a key and made to follow its operator. An engraving on its back marks it as the captain’s property.
Innkeeper Shaussiy offers travelers rest beneath Elune’s guidance, a place to make their home, and goods to browse. Her inn centers on rest and hospitality, with a Trick or Treat interaction as well.

The Den Mother is a hostile creature dwelling in a cave northeast of Bashal’Aran. Tharnariun identifies her as the final target in his effort to ease the forest’s suffering, and she uses Ravage in combat.
Yalda is a named individual found in Darkshore.
Flagglemurk the Cruel is a formidable named combatant who casts spells in battle, including one as his health falls.
Lady Vespira is a formidable named combatant who uses ranged shots and forked lightning, and can knock down nearby foes.
Lord Sinslayer is a formidable named combatant who casts spells in battle, including one as his health falls.

Gershala Nightwhisper studies the mutations of satyrs and naga, hoping their corruption will help him understand and prevent a similar fate for the blood elves. His research focuses on corrupted brain stems from Blackfathom Deeps.
Jaelysia is a stable master who offers pet stabling and help recovering lost companions.
Moonkin Oracle is a moonkin in Darkshore.
Moonkin is a moonkin in Darkshore.
Young Moonkin is a moonkin in Darkshore.
Raging Moonkin is a moonkin in Darkshore that can become enraged.

Gubber Blump is an enthusiastic fisherman in Auberdine, where he teaches visitors the basics of fishing and offers spare poles and bait at his cost. He says fishing runs in the Blump family; after murlocs disrupted boat trips, he asks for help obtaining local seafood.

Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is an Auberdine researcher sent by the Temple of the Moon to investigate why large sea creatures are washing ashore along Darkshore. Murlocs have made her field research difficult, so she asks others to recover remains from beached or nearby creatures. She studies the samples and reports findings to the Temple in Darnassus; she regards the possibility that creatures are fleeing the area around Teldrassil as disturbing, and says the research is still in its infancy.

Murkdeep is a murloc identified by the Auberdine Village Council as a wanted creature. The council says he is suspected of killing at least one Sentinel and sinking cargo vessels, and was last spotted at a murloc camp south of Auberdine, where he is thought to defend the huts. These are accusations and suspicions in the bounty notice.
A Shatterspear troll in Darkshore.
Jenna Lemkenilli is an Engineering Trainer. Her greeting introduces her by name and asks the visitor's.
A Shatterspear drummer in Darkshore.

Kerlonian Evershade is a Druid of the Claw who asks for help reaching Liladris Moonriver at Maestra's Post after stopping for a nap on the way there. Since waking from the Emerald Dream, he has been unusually sleepy and may drift off during the journey; he asks to be woken with his horn. He says the route can be dangerous and hopes for companions.

Sentinel Aynasha was carrying an important message to Auberdine when Marosh and his furbolg trackers attacked and poisoned her. She asks for protection while she prepares an antidote, and says she will defend herself with her bow. After recovering, she intends to report the incident to her superiors; she directs the player to Sentinel Onaeya at Maestra's Post.
Voriya is a humanoid in Darkshore.
Una Ji'ro is a humanoid in Darkshore.
Krah'ranik is a humanoid found in Darkshore.
Jory Zaga is a humanoid found in Darkshore.
A sickly deer found across Darkshore.

Thamarian is a transport guide on the Auberdine docks. His directions describe ship passage from the northern dock to Rut'theran Village and Darnassus, from the southern dock to Stormwind Harbor, and from the western pier to Azuremyst Isle near the Exodar.

Elder Starweave is a night elf elder who speaks of the stars as signs of hope and strength in the ages ahead. She can direct visitors asking after Elders Bladeswift, Nightwind, and Riversong. Her words connect the changing heavens with earthly mysteries.

The Darkshore Flame Warden tends the Alliance festival flame and invites visitors to honor it. The warden urges Alliance folk to honor fires across Alliance lands, while calling Horde festival fires unworthy and encouraging their desecration.

Crown Thugs are targets in Detective Snap Snagglebolt’s investigation around Ambermill in Silverpine Forest. He asks adventurers to defeat them as part of his assignment; the available evidence does not establish individual traits or speech.

place_records.text: You are in Darkshore, Alliance land on the coast of Kalimdor. Auberdine is its main settlement, and Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea guards it and the forest around it. Thistle bears prowl the woods, Greymist murlocs roam the coast, Stormscale creatures haunt the ruins, and Blackwood furbolgs trouble the river. Twilight's Hammer cultists also gather in the south at the Master's Glaive.

You are in Auberdine, an Alliance village in Darkshore. It has an inn, a flight master, trainers, repairs and a stable. Sentinel Elissa Starbreeze keeps watch over it, and the scholar Thundris Windweaver is troubled by a taint in the Cliffspring River.
You are in the Ruins of Mathystra, a ruined site in Darkshore. Stormscale myrmidons, sorceresses and warriors are the dangers there.

You are in the Tower of Althalaxx, a tower in Darkshore that Dark Strand cultists have filled. Warlocks gather around and inside it, with Dark Strand fanatics and voidcallers among them. Athrikus Narassin is believed to be at its top.
You are in Cliffspring Falls, where Stormscale wave riders and sirens are the dangers. The Grove of the Ancients senses a new evil in the cave behind the falls.

You are in Bashal'Aran, a ruin of the Highborne in Darkshore, where wild grells, vile sprites and satyrs feed on the magic of the place. The spectral Highborne Asterion is held here by a magical seal that he wants destroyed.

You are in Ameth'Aran, a ruined Highborne city in Darkshore haunted by the spirits of its dead. Writhing, wailing and cursed Highborne roam the ruins, and the restless night elf spirit Anaya Dawnrunner lingers there.

You are in the Grove of the Ancients, a Darkshore grove where the Ancient of Lore Onu studies the old powers the Twilight's Hammer cult reveres. Ullanna and Tiyani sell trade goods and food and drink, and moonstalker sires prowl close by.

You are in the Master's Glaive, a Darkshore site to the south where an old lord of the earth fell. Twilight's Hammer thugs and disciples gather here, and the firecaller Radison is among them. The young elf Therylune was caught here by them.

You are in Remtravel's Excavation, an Explorers' League dig in Darkshore. The prospector Remtravel, famed for discoveries at Ironforge's academy, is working here while cracked golems and stone behemoths overrun the site.

You are in Mist's Edge, a stretch of Darkshore coast where the Cliffspring River empties into the sea. The pirate Gelkak Gyromast is stranded here after his ship sank offshore, and his mechanical first mate is broken. Threshers and Greymist murlocs roam the coast, and the transport guide Thamarian directs ship passage to Darnassus and Stormwind Harbor.
You are in The Long Wash, an area of Darkshore. Darkshore threshers, Greymist coastrunners and raiders are the dangers there, and the shade of Elura lingers.
You are in Blackwood Den, a cave in Darkshore where Blackwood furbolgs dwell. Blackwood ursas and shamans roam within, and the wounded Volcor was found here after evading the furbolgs.
You are in Cliffspring River, a river in Darkshore. Blackwood warriors, Moonstalkers and rabid thistle bears haunt the river, and Blackwood totemics are among its dangers.

You are in Twilight Vale, a part of Darkshore where Alliance sentinels are at work. Sentinel Tysha Moonblade is studying the ruins of Ameth'Aran to the east, though she once fled from restless spirits there while reading the tablets. Moonstalkers and Grizzled thistle bears roam the vale, and a spirit healer offers a return to the living for a price.

You are in Twilight Shore, a rocky inlet on the Darkshore coast. Greymist murlocs have made camp around several beached sea creatures, and Darkshore threshers and Greymist tidehunters are among the dangers, with a vendor here.
